title: COVID-19 Contact-Tracing Mobile Apps: Evaluation And Assessment For Decision Makers
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is to provide a comprehensive ethical framework for evaluating COVID-19 contact-tracing applications. It delves deeply into moral and ethical questions concerning user privacy, data security, consent, potential for stigmatization, and the balance between public health objectives and individual rights. The core of the document is a set of evaluation questions centered on these ethical considerations, making it a paper about assessing technology through an ethical lens.
